name: Dazzling Sphinx
oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, that player exiles cards from the top of their library until they exile an instant or sorcery card. You may cast that card without paying its mana cost. Then that player puts the exiled cards that weren't cast this way on the bottom of their library in a random order.
blocked_sentences: Then that player puts the exiled cards that weren't cast this way on the bottom of their library in a random order.

needs.what: a `rest_to_bottom` option on `exile_until` that, after the free-cast offer resolves, puts every card the walk exiled (the walked-past cards plus the hit if it was not cast) on the bottom of the walked library's owner's library in a random order -- the cascade/discover tail, on exile_until's selector stop test and `player` walk of another seat's library (here the damaged player, from a deals_combat_damage_to_player trigger)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: exile_until (player = the damaged player, objects {any_types: [Instant, Sorcery]}, cast_free) does the first two sentences, but by design leaves every walked card in exile; `else_destination` moves only the uncast hit, `as` binds only the hit, and the walked-past cards are not linked to the source, so a following put_on_top with `bottom` and `exiled_with` cannot find them (and put_on_top has no random order). `cascade` and `discover` bottom the rest in a random order but walk only the controller's library with a mana-value stop test; `reveal_until` bottoms the rest but reveals rather than exiles and offers no immediate free cast.
